# Ski Info

> Free piste maps and run-by-run slope data for 1,400+ ski resorts in 45 countries (Alps, Pyrenees, North America, Scandinavia, Japan, Andes…), in 7 languages. Every run has its gradient profile (slope % and degrees stretch by stretch, and its steepest 50 m stretch), on an interactive satellite map with a 3D terrain view, plus lifts, on-mountain services and a 7-day snow forecast. Run and lift data come from OpenStreetMap (via OpenSkiMap, ODbL).

What makes it different from official piste maps: the slope is measured from the terrain, so you can compare how steep runs really are, whatever their official colour. Slope colours follow the ATUDEM (Spain) / AFNOR (France) thresholds: under 15% gentle, 15–25% moderate, 25–40% steep, over 40% very steep. Elevations come from a ~30 m terrain model, so very short steps may not show.

## Resort pages

One page per resort and language with every named run (length, vertical, average and maximum slope), lifts, services and the snow forecast:

- [Baqueira Beret (Spanish)](https://skiinfoapp.com/estacion/baqueira-beret/)
- [Tignes - Val d'Isère (English)](https://skiinfoapp.com/en/resort/tignes-val-d-isere/)
- [Val Thorens (French)](https://skiinfoapp.com/fr/station/val-thorens/)
- [Zermatt - Breuil-Cervinia (German)](https://skiinfoapp.com/de/skigebiet/zermatt-breuil-cervinia/)
- [All countries (English)](https://skiinfoapp.com/en/country/)
- [Sitemap with every page](https://skiinfoapp.com/sitemap.xml)

URL patterns: `/estacion/<slug>/` (es), `/en/resort/<slug>/`, `/fr/station/<slug>/`, `/de/skigebiet/<slug>/`, `/it/stazione/<slug>/`, `/nl/skigebied/<slug>/`, `/pl/osrodek/<slug>/`.

## Interactive map

- [Web app](https://skiinfoapp.com/en/): search a resort, open its map (2D satellite or 3D terrain), colour runs by difficulty or by real slope, tap a run for its profile, "Where am I" on the slopes, and a beta route planner ("route to here", with a level filter such as no black runs).

## Guides

Rankings built from the same data: steepest runs, biggest resorts, ski resorts near a city, where it will snow this week.

- [Guides (English)](https://skiinfoapp.com/en/guides/)
- [Guías (Spanish)](https://skiinfoapp.com/guias/)
